entities.name: Zdeněk Chládek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zdeňek Hládek is a Czech boxer. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, he competed in the Men's light welterweight, but was defeated by Mongolian Uranchimegiin Mönkh-Erdene in the first match. His height is 1.0 m.
